mapper.sql:
ORDER BY
v.company_name DESC, v.visit_no v.work_start_dt DESC, v.visit_no v.reg_dt DESC, v.visit_no v.visit_no DESC

v.visit_no, v.visit_type, v.status_code, v.work_purpose, v.company_type, v.company_name, v.receiver, v.returner, v.evidence_file, v.remark, v.del_yn, v.reg_dt, v.mod_dt, CONVERT(varchar(10), v.permit_dt, 23) AS permit_dt, CONVERT(varchar(16), v.work_start_dt, 126) AS work_start_dt, CONVERT(varchar(16), v.work_end_dt, 126) AS work_end_dt, pt.code_name AS visit_type_name, vs.code_name AS status_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_visit_person vp WHERE vp.visit_no = v.visit_no) AS person_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_visit_car vc WHERE vc.visit_no = v.visit_no) AS car_count
FROM tb_visit v LEFT JOIN tb_common pt ON pt.cmm_id = 'PT' AND pt.code_id = v.visit_type LEFT JOIN tb_common vs ON vs.cmm_id = 'VS' AND vs.code_id = v.status_code
mapper.select:
SELECT
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_visit (visit_type, status_code, work_purpose, permit_dt, work_start_dt, work_end_dt, company_type, company_name, receiver, returner, evidence_file, remark) VALUES (#{visitType}, #{statusCode}, #{workPurpose}, #{permitDt}, #{workStartDt}, #{workEndDt}, #{companyType}, #{companyName}, #{receiver}, #{returner}, #{evidenceFile}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_visit SET visit_type = #{visitType}, status_code = #{statusCode}, work_purpose = #{workPurpose}, permit_dt = #{permitDt}, work_start_dt = #{workStartDt}, work_end_dt = #{workEndDt}, company_type = #{companyType}, company_name = #{companyName}, receiver = #{receiver}, returner = #{returner}, remark = #{remark}, mod_dt = getdate() WHERE visit_no = #{visitNo}
UPDATE tb_visit SET del_yn = 'Y', mod_dt = getdate() WHERE visit_no = #{visitNo}
UPDATE tb_visit SET status_code = #{statusCode}, mod_dt = getdate() WHERE visit_no = #{visitNo}
mapper.select: SELECT person_id FROM tb_visit_manager WHERE visit_no = #{visitNo} ORDER BY seq
mapper.insert:

mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT m.person_id FROM tb_visit_manager m JOIN tb_visit v ON v.visit_no = m.visit_no WHERE v.visit_type = 'PT02' AND v.del_yn = 'N' AND v.status_code IN ('VS01', 'VS03') AND m.person_id IN #{pid}
AND v.visit_no <> #{excludeVisitNo}
SELECT person_id FROM tb_visit_person WHERE visit_no = #{visitNo}
SELECT car_id FROM tb_visit_car WHERE visit_no = #{visitNo}
SELECT ac_group_id FROM tb_visit_ac_group WHERE visit_no = #{visitNo}
SELECT code_id FROM tb_visit_car_ac_group WHERE visit_no = #{visitNo} ORDER BY code_id
